subject: Scope & Capacity Addendum — implementation timeline and MSA exhibit reference
messages:
From: Ben Cooper <ben.cooper@healthsync.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 10, 2027 at 09:15 AM PST
Subject: Request: add 3x Dedicated GPUs + SOW edits

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is happy with latency on the test prompts. We need to move quickly: our product roadmap has shifted and we need to add 3x dedicated GPUs for inference capacity and update the SOW to reflect a phased rollout (pilot -> ramp -> steady state).

High-level asks:
- Add 3 dedicated GPUs (Q3 start) and a short-term burst pool during ramp.
- Adjust implementation timeline: pilot in 4 weeks, full ramp in 10 weeks.
- Update acceptance criteria to include two performance tests (95th pct latency and token throughput).
- Pricing: please indicate incremental monthly fee and one-time implementation fee.

Can you send a draft change order or redlines we can review? Procurement (procurement@healthsync.com) is on copy for invoices and PO details.

Attached is our internal project brief.

Thanks,
Ben
Product Ops — HealthSync
[Attachment: HealthSync_ProjectBrief_v1.pdf]

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Ben Cooper <ben.cooper@healthsync.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, Feb 11, 2027 at 08:40 AM PST
Subject: Re: Request: add 3x Dedicated GPUs + SOW edits

Ben —

Appreciate the clear asks. I put together an initial redline of the SOW and an outline for a change order that covers the capacity add, phased timeline, and acceptance tests. See attached PDF (HealthSync_SOW_v2_redlines.pdf).

Next steps I propose:
1) Karthik to confirm pricing/band for the 3x GPUs and the one-time implementation delta.
2) We’ll route a tracked change change-order doc for legal review; Jordan will handle the MSA exhibit reference and signature path.
3) Quick sync w/ procurement if the PO/invoice timing needs to be aligned to the pilot start.

I’m available for a 30m call tomorrow afternoon if you want to walk the redlines together.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: HealthSync_SOW_v2_redlines.pdf]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Cooper <ben.cooper@healthsync.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 12, 2027 at 10:05 AM PST
Subject: Re: Request: add 3x Dedicated GPUs + SOW edits

Thanks, Irene — reviewing the redlines now. A few pricing notes for coordination:
- Incremental monthly fee: recommend using the existing tiered rate card and apply a 10% ramp discount for the first two months of the pilot. That preserves predictability while reducing friction for HealthSync to start.
- One-time implementation fee: estimate $12,000 (project engineering + onboarding), subject to scope confirmation.

I attached a draft ChangeOrder_Draft.docx with line items and the proposed fee schedule. Two open questions for HealthSync:
1) Will the burst pool be billed as consumed tokens, or as a reserved short-term bucket?
2) Confirmation on the performance SLA target (we proposed 95th pct latency < 180ms for the pilot).

If those are agreed, I’ll route the pricing to finance for a formal quote and then Jordan can fold it into the MSA amendment.

-Karthik
Head of Pricing & Commercial Operations
[Attachment: ChangeOrder_Draft.docx]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Ben Cooper <ben.cooper@healthsync.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 13, 2027 at 09:22 AM PST
Subject: Re: Request: add 3x Dedicated GPUs + SOW edits

Ben / team —

Looping in legal side of the workflow. Quick notes from a contract perspective:
- We will implement the capacity change as a Change Order referencing Section 4 of the MSA and Exhibit B (Order Form / Capacity). Please confirm HealthSync is agreeable to the Change Order referencing the existing MSA by contract ID (MSA-RED-2025-02).
- We need to be explicit about the billing model for the burst pool (consumption vs reserved). If HealthSync wants reserved short-term capacity, that needs a minimum commit clause for that bucket; otherwise we will treat burst as consumed and appear on monthly usage.
- On acceptance criteria: the SOW redlines look fine; please confirm the test vectors and thresholds in Acceptance_Criteria_20270214.xlsx.

I will prepare a tracked-change Change Order template for signatures and a DocuSign envelope once HealthSync confirms the billing model and signs off on the test criteria. If HealthSync prefers countersigning on their DocuSign instance, provide the Admin contact and we’ll coordinate.

-Jordan Blake
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Governance_Checklist.pdf]

From: Ben Cooper <ben.cooper@healthsync.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, Feb 14, 2027 at 08:12 AM PST
Subject: Re: Request: add 3x Dedicated GPUs + SOW edits

Jordan / Irene —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Procurement prefers the burst pool billed as consumed (monthly usage) to avoid committing extra reserved units up front. That should be fine for our finance cadence.

We reviewed the acceptance criteria spreadsheet and made two small edits to the test vector set (see attached Acceptance_Criteria_20270214.xlsx). Implementation timeline: we can start pilot set-up the week of March 8, which shifts the earlier dates in your redline by ~2 weeks. That works for our PMs.

Procurement contact: procurement@healthsync.com (cc’d). Finance will issue a PO after we receive the formal quote and the DocuSign envelope.

Ben
Product Ops — HealthSync
[Attachment: Acceptance_Criteria_20270214.xlsx]

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Ben Cooper <ben.cooper@healthsync.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, Feb 15, 2027 at 11:05 AM PST
Subject: Re: Request: add 3x Dedicated GPUs + SOW edits

Ben / team —

Summary and next steps:
1) Pricing: Karthik will finalize a formal quote with the 10% ramp discount and $12k implementation fee; quote to HealthSync by EOD Feb 16.
2) Billing model: burst pool billed on consumption per HealthSync confirmation.
3) Legal: Jordan will issue a tracked Change Order referencing MSA-RED-2025-02 and Exhibit B; expect DocuSign envelope next week. If HealthSync wants to countersign in DocuSign, reply with the admin contact.
4) Timeline: pilot start week of March 8; update redline dates accordingly.
5) Action: Ben/procurement to return PO once quote and DocuSign are received.

I’ll set a 30m sync for Thurs Feb 18 to walk the final redlines if that helps.

Thanks all —
Irene
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | redwood.com
[Attachments: HealthSync_SOW_v2_redlines.pdf, ChangeOrder_Draft.docx]
